name: enrich
description: In progress: ctrl+x r sends your draft prompt to Claude (Sonnet 5.5 by default) and puts it back rewritten for clarity. Press it again to restore your original.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model that rewrites your draft: an alias (sonnet, haiku, opus) or a full model id.

effort.title: Effort
effort.description: How hard the model thinks. low keeps a rewrite to a few seconds.

instructions.title: Rewrite instructions
instructions.description: How the model rewrites your draft. Edit or replace them to set your own style, such as "Add success criteria as a checklist." Whatever they say, @mentions, paths and code stay exactly as written, and the reply is only the rewritten prompt. Clear the field to go back to the default.
instructions.default: Rewrite it for clarity. Fix spelling and grammar. Make the ask explicit: what to do, and to what. Turn several separate asks into a short list; otherwise keep prose. Keep the author's voice, terms and hedges ("maybe", "not sure"). Add nothing the draft doesn't say: no new requirements, files or names.
